report.claimBoundary: Six deterministic single-carton scenarios against M8 build 8001 using the preserved Muse world. No paid model or HMI evidence, no broader controller coverage.

plan.objective: Connect preserved Muse world and M9 runtime to M8

findings.title: M10 sort-a: observed deterministic oracle
findings.inference: Deterministic scenario oracle passed against correlated PLC observations; physical behavior is independently retained in world evidence.
assumptions: Preserved world 0.5.0 physical assumptions; one carton; M8 declared timer/oracle settings
findings.uncertainty: Only the executed scenario and measured transport are established; no HMI or paid Muse proof.
